items.text: Puka Nacua listed QUESTIONABLE (calf) for Sunday; will test pregame per McVay. Status crucial for DFS slate.
items.why: Calf issue limited/missed practice; felt lack of power/explosion.
items.implication: Game-time; if OUT Rams TE target share spikes (37% prior Puka absences).
items.opportunity: Higbee lead TE targets if out

items.text: Lamar Jackson QUESTIONABLE (ankle) for Sunday vs Bengals. Crucial DFS status.
items.why: Ankle; heading right direction per Jackson but GTD possible.
items.implication: Ravens offense hinges; monitor early news.

items.text: Breece Hall QUESTIONABLE (quad) after limited practices; status key for slate.
items.why: Quad; limited this week after missing 3.
items.implication: If active start vs MIA; else Allen upside.

items.text: OUTs include Davante Adams, Rashee Rice, Jeremiyah Love, David Montgomery, Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren, Zach Charbonnet, Brian Robinson.
items.implication: Clear benches; handcuff/backup upsides (e.g. Walker without Charbonnet).

items.text: 49ers ruled out Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel for Sunday in Atlanta; also Bosa etc.
items.why: Evans Achilles/ribs; Deebo hamstring. Coach confirm.

items.text: Josh Jacobs listed IN; was at facility for meetings/lifting/treatment (non-football).
items.why: Cleared activities; backups Lloyd/Johnson poor EPA.
items.implication: Start but monitor workload post-layoff; Berry hates.

items.text: Tempted to buy CMC lining up more at slot amid 49ers WR injuries despite rarely trusting RB-as-WR hype; Kaelon Black presence.
items.why: Dire WR situation; CMC smile on question.

items.text: If Breece Hall plays vs Dolphins, going right back into starting lineup despite Stephania Bell caution.
If Puka Nacua can't go, Stafford hierarchy: 1. Tyler Higbee 2. Konata Mumpfield 3. Colby Parkinson 4. Tutu Atwell etc.
items.implication: TE-heavy if out amid Adams IR.

items.text: Colston Loveland BACK (thank Caleb): 30% TS, 19.2 PPR/g, 6+ rec/60+ yds both games since Williams return.
Brian Robinson OUT; SF DvP inflates opposing RBs 4.4% (7th most). Sweet for Bijan full workload: recent SF RB catches (White/Holani/Harvey/Love).
items.why: BRob hamstring OUT; SF soft vs RBs.

items.text: George Kittle will go nuts: awesome scheme + entire 49ers WR corps hurt (Evans/Deebo OUT). Not National TE Day.
Bears TE Cole Kmet to IR, season-ending knee; coach Johnson: big part of heartbeat.
Luther Burden 68.8% routes but elite 2.56 YPRR; Kmet IR may reduce 2/3-sets giving more juice.
